`final class GlTexture`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Texture`](/reference/bridges/texture/)<br/>
**Implements:** [`IGlTexture`](/reference/base-opengl/igltexture/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.opengl.render.texture` · **Module:** `base-opengl` · **Source:** [GlTexture.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/opengl/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/opengl/render/texture/GlTexture.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 2</span> <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

A texture of OpenGL with RGBA8 storage for every level, uploaded as BGRA.

## Description

A texture larger than the maximum size of the context throws an `IllegalArgumentException` that starts with `A texture of`.

## Learn more

- [Textures, framebuffers, shaders](/build/base-modules/opengl/#textures-framebuffers-shaders)

## Creation details

<a id="GlTexture-factory-create"></a>

### create

`GlTexture create(GlRenderBridge bridge)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Creates the OpenGL texture, without storage; [`GlRenderBridge.createTexture`](/reference/base-opengl/glrenderbridge/#GlRenderBridge-method-createTexture) calls it.

## Method details

<a id="GlTexture-method-sample"></a>

### sample

`void sample(TextureSampling sampling)` 

Sets the filter and the wrap of the bound texture, sending only the parameters that changed since the last sampling.

<a id="GlTexture-method-forgetSampling"></a>

### forgetSampling

`void forgetSampling()` 

Forgets the last sampling, so that the next `sample` sends every parameter.

<a id="GlTexture-method-getId"></a>

### getId

`int getId()` 

Returns the OpenGL name of the texture.

<a id="GlTexture-method-getBridge"></a>

### getBridge

`GlRenderBridge getBridge()` 

Returns the render bridge that created the texture.

<a id="GlTexture-method-getSampling"></a>

### getSampling

`TextureSampling getSampling()` 

Returns the last sampling sent to OpenGL, or `null` when none is known.
